title: Release Proof Truth: current contract uses committed evidence

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.182 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run passes.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed v0.15.182 release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow release-proof fix; Fast verification plus normal local gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: No new provider package is claimed. A fresh deployed GPT-5.4-mini audit remains required after Pages serves v0.15.182.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: The v0.15.181 Fast verification failure was caused by a current release contract anchoring ignored verification-output files that clean CI checkouts do not have.
The v0.15.181 historical contract now uses committed roadmap proof instead of a local-only regrade JSON anchor.
proofCommands: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('release-contracts/v0.15.181.json','utf8')); const anchors=c.claims.flatMap((claim)=>claim.anchors||[]); if (anchors.some((anchor)=>anchor.startsWith('verification-output/'))) process.exit(1);"

claims.summary: The current release contract uses only committed docs, source, tests, and release-contract files as required anchors.
The release is limited to version, release manifest, release contract, roadmap, and release-ledger test updates.
proofCommands: rg -n "not a compiler, grader, source-ledger, or export behavior change|This release does not change compiler" docs/V0.15.182_RELEASE_PROOF_TRUTH_ROADMAP.md src/lib/releaseManifest.js

claims.summary: A fresh deployed GPT-5.4-mini ZIP/log audit remains required before claiming the discussion texture fix in real provider output.
proofCommands: rg -n "fresh deployed GPT-5.4-mini ZIP/log audit|Fresh provider proof remains the next gate" docs/V0.15.182_RELEASE_PROOF_TRUTH_ROADMAP.md src/lib/releaseManifest.js

knownRemainingTargets: A fresh deployed v0.15.182 GPT-5.4-mini ZIP/log audit must verify whether the v0.15.181 discussion texture rotation improves real output beyond the v0.15.180 96/100 baseline.
Texture below 100 remains a monitoring target even when the package rounds to clean 100/A.
Release contracts should keep required anchors in committed files so local release-history audits cannot pass on laptop-only evidence that CI cannot see.
A clean release claim still requires UI, ZIP, manifest, QUALITY_REPORT, SOURCE_REPORT, digest, and local regrade agreement.
